safety.title: Safety notice
safety.p1: For your safety, do not under any circumstances enter properties without identification, without visible signs from the producer, or that could put your safety at risk.
safety.p2: Always confirm the collection place given by the farmer before you travel, and prefer to travel during daylight hours.
safety.scheduled: Collection scheduled: {{date}} at {{time}}. The farmer receives the order with this time.
safety.p3: ValorRural is not responsible for the acts of third parties or for people's physical safety during collection.
safety.confirm: I understand and want to continue
